Rules / Maintainability

SK7073 A region is empty

A #region and its #endregion have only whitespace between them.

CategoryMaintainability
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixyes, safe
Language version floor—
Since1.3

Why

A region survives every deletion inside it, so an empty one is the residue of a member that moved or went away. It is a heading over nothing, and the outline it produces claims a structure the file does not have. The fix deletes the two directive lines, which is the whole of the edit: nothing else in the file changes and no token moves.

Example

Instead of:

#region Serialization
#endregion

Write:

// Delete the directives; the members they grouped are gone.

When it does not fire

Only whitespace counts as nothing. A comment, a #pragma, a #if and in particular inactive #if text are all content, and the rule stays quiet — a region that still says something to a reader is not the residue this is about, and inactive text is code under another set of preprocessor symbols. The one exception is a nested region, so that a region holding only another region is one edit rather than two skala fix passes. A #region the parser could not match to an #endregion is skipped, because deleting one half of an unbalanced pair would be an edit made on a guess.
